text: First-time home buyers in Orange County — what surprised you most about the process? Trying to prepare myself before we start looking early next year.
comment_source_reason: A question only recent or current OC home buyers can really answer pulls first-time buyers into the replies, along with agents, loan officers and title/escrow professionals volunteering their expertise — the client's buyer types answering directly.

comments: Congrats on starting the journey! Happy to walk you through the OC market whenever you're ready, feel free to reach out
The biggest surprise for most of my clients is how fast good listings move here - if you want I can set you up on an alert system, I'm an agent in the area
Chào bạn, mình là agent ở khu Little Saigon, thị trường OC cạnh tranh lắm, cần hỗ trợ gì cứ nhắn mình nha
My sister bought her first place in Tustin last year, she said her agent was amazing, I can ask for the contact if you want
My coworker just went through this, said the loan officer he used made everything way less stressful, let me ask for his info
Bạn thân mình mới mua nhà xong, để mình hỏi nó chia sẻ kinh nghiệm cho bạn
Following, need this info too lol
Surprise: you're broke forever now 💀
real 😭
Not a buyer but I do home inspections in OC - biggest surprise for most people is how much a good inspection actually saves them, happy to answer questions
The escrow process itself surprises a lot of first timers honestly, happy to explain how it works if useful!
We went through this in Sacramento, totally different market but the closing costs shock was universal lol
I'm down in San Diego but the process is pretty similar - biggest surprise for my clients is always the closing costs
This is all super helpful, thank you everyone! Definitely feeling more prepared now, appreciate the honesty about the closing costs 😅
We bought back in 2018, no complaints, just chiming in to say the appraisal process was way more nerve-wracking than expected
Bought our first home in Yorba Linda 6 years ago and never looked back, definitely miss nothing about renting
We just closed on our first place in Tustin last month! Biggest surprise was how much good comps actually mattered for the offer strategy
Bon minh moi mua nha dau tien xong o Fountain Valley, bat ngo nhat la tien closing cost cao hon minh nghi nhieu
Currently in escrow on our first house in Lake Forest, the inspection contingency stuff has been way more stressful than I expected
Nhà mình cũng đang trong quá trình mua căn đầu tiên ở Anaheim, hồi hộp lắm, chưa biết gì nhiều nên đọc thread này học hỏi
We closed on our first home in Orange back in the spring - the biggest shock honestly was how competitive multiple-offer situations still are
First time buyer here too, still actively looking in the Mission Viejo area, offers keep getting outbid though
Vợ chồng em cũng đang tìm mua nhà đầu tiên bên Westminster, giá lên xuống liên tục làm em rối quá
Just got our keys to our first place in Costa Mesa two weeks ago, the paperwork volume was honestly the biggest surprise
We're actively house hunting right now for our first home, mostly looking around Fullerton, still adjusting to how fast things move
Nhà mình mới ký hợp đồng mua nhà tuần trước ở khu Garden Grove, đang chờ đóng escrow, hồi hộp lắm mọi người
Closed on our first house in Aliso Viejo this past winter, and honestly we're already talking about maybe upgrading in a few years once we have kids
We're first-time buyers currently under contract in Brea, the amount of paperwork alone has been eye opening
Gia đình mình cũng đang mua nhà đầu tiên ở Huntington Beach, mọi thứ diễn ra nhanh quá không kịp trở tay
Bought our starter home in Placentia just this summer, biggest surprise was honestly how much negotiating room there still was
Currently first-time home shopping in the Cypress area, the rate lock stuff has been more confusing than I expected
Nhà mình mua xong hồi tháng trước ở Stanton, giờ mới thấm cái vụ property tax reassessment nó cao thiệt
We closed a few months back on our first place near Irvine, and we're honestly already eyeing a bigger house down the line
Still in the process of buying our first home, currently in Buena Park, the sheer number of disclosures caught me off guard
Bọn em đang trong giai đoạn tìm mua nhà đầu tiên ở khu Little Saigon, giá nhà lên hoài làm em căng thẳng ghê
Recently closed on our first condo in Santa Ana, and we're already saving up to move into a single family home within a couple years
Currently under contract on our first house in Yorba Linda, the whole underwriting back-and-forth has been the most surprising part honestly
Nhà mình cũng vừa mua xong tháng trước ở Anaheim Hills, đang tính sau này mua thêm 1 căn đầu tư nữa
We're first time buyers actively looking around Laguna Niguel right now, the price swings week to week have been wild
Closed on our first house in San Clemente two months ago, and honestly we're planning to house hack and rent the ADU
Vợ chồng mình đang tìm mua nhà ở Rancho Santa Margarita, đây là căn đầu tiên nên hồi hộp lắm, cảm ơn mọi người chia sẻ
